translations.answer: After official merge of PR #2128, the ArticulationData.body_incoming_joint_wrench_b should be read. The PR document specifies its shape as (num_instances, num_bodies, 6), representing the joint reaction wrench from the parent body to the child body in the parent body frame, with the last dimension being 6 for force and torque. It is not the same interface as the isaacsim.core.articulations API and is not equivalent to any installed pose F/T sensor.
translations.applicability: Applies to Isaac Lab ArticulationData; older versions and isaacsim.core.articulations API should be handled according to their own documentation.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and free of conflict, and there is formal documentation or exact citation of independent reproducibility.
translations.details.attempts.0: The issue participant asked about get_measured_joint_forces/efforts; the collaborator clarified they are different APIs and pointed to the PR #2128 being added.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Distinguish between the isaacsim.core.articulations API and the Isaac Lab ArticulationData API.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Verify the target version includes PR #2128 and confirm the wrench is expressed in the parent body frame with the last dimension as 6.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Read ArticulationData.body_incoming_joint_wrench_b in versions containing PR #2128 of the Isaac Lab; it is obtained from get_link_incoming_joint_force and cached as a 6D tensor per body.
translations.details.environments.0: Isaac Lab Articulation API; PR #2128 was merged into the official repository on 2025-05-03; the original thread did not provide Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab release versions.
translations.details.limits.0: This field is the parent-to-child proximal joint reaction wrench, not equivalent to any installed pose F/T sensor.
translations.details.limits.1: The thread does not provide noise, bandwidth, filtering, or real-world sensor consistency validation.
translations.details.outcomes.0: PR #2128 has been merged, and static wrench value tests for CPU/CUDA and single/multi-articulation have been added.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How to consistently obtain each body's proximal joint 6D force/torque reaction wrench in the current Isaac Lab Articulation?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Before using the reaction wrench for collision/overload protection, independently verify the sign, body order, coordinate transformation, threshold, and update delay; do not rely solely on simulation reaction wrench to trigger real-world safety actions.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Cross-version and API layer duplication of old calls, leading to confusion in method ownership and return semantics.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Different old issues mix isaacsim.core.articulations and Isaac Lab Articulation API, causing users to be unable to determine which get_measured_* call is applicable to the current version.
translations.source.locator: IsaacLab #2127: collaborator comments on 2789530049 explain the new field; PR #2128 was merged and contains static 10 N/10 Nm test.
translations.source.title: Isaac Lab uses body_incoming_joint_wrench_b to read each body's proximal joint 6D force/torque reaction wrench and confirm its coordinate system and shape.
translations.terms.1: Joint Reaction Wrench (关节反作用力矩)
translations.terms.2: Parent Body Frame (父刚体坐标系)
